versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the "first-principles-thinking" skill.
- Provides a framework to help users rethink problems from core needs, challenge assumptions, and propose better solutions.
- Offers clear guidance on when to apply (and when not to apply) first principles thinking.
- Includes practical question frameworks, triggering scenarios, and example conversations to illustrate proper usage.
- Emphasizes avoiding over-analysis for simple or routine tasks.
